world.title: What this column is for
world.body: News from outside the campus that a student still needs to know: exam bodies, bursaries and scholarships, national holidays, transport, anything that moves a semester. Every item here is written inside Campus Connect by a campus account. Nothing is pulled from the internet, because this app has no server doing that, and an invented headline would be worse than an empty column.

university.title: Your university's own news
university.body: Timetables, fee deadlines, hostel and canteen notices, results, sports, chapel, graduation. A student, lecturer or security account writes an announcement in the box at the bottom of this page, and everyone - including a parent who only has an email account - reads it here. These notes stay until the first real announcement replaces them.

people.title: The people in it
people.body: Student achievements, societies and clubs, lecturers, alumni, and good news from families and friends. If you are a parent or a relative, this is the column that tells you how the campus is doing.
